correctness.rationale: For G(n,m), condition X=degree(v)=x; a shared edge vw is Bernoulli(x/s), while the degree contribution from the remaining t=M-s edges is an independent Hypergeom(t,s-1,m-x) variable. The conditional falling-factorial moment is polynomial in x with leading coefficient rho_j=(-1)^j(s-1)_j/(t)_j+(-1)^(j-1)j(s-1)_(j-1)/(s(t)_(j-1)). Reversibility of the exchangeable degree pair makes this conditional expectation operator self-adjoint on the one-degree hypergeometric measure; polynomial filtration plus orthogonality diagonalize all Q_j with eigenvalues rho_j. The histogram covariance is n times identity plus n(n-1) times this exchangeability kernel on centered scores; j=0 is constant, j=1 gives zero because 2m deterministic, and all j>=2 have lambda_j=n[1+(n-1)rho_j], independent of m apart from support r. Independently enumerated all simple fixed-edge labeled graphs for (n,m)=(4,2),(5,3),(5,5),(6,7), computed exact covariance and normalized spectra; observed (4,2):2.666667; (5,3):4,7; (5,5):4,4,7; (6,7):5.2,5.342857,6.142857,7.4 plus the two zero modes. Boundary singleton support treated as zero and n>=4 ensures denominator support.
